notes:
{竹|たけ} refers to bamboo, a plant with deep cultural significance in Japan.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{竹の子|たけのこ}→筍：17667_takenoko⟧/⟦{筍|たけのこ}→筍：17667_takenoko⟧: bamboo shoot (a popular spring food)

- ⟦{竹刀|しない}→竹刀：27833_shinai⟧: bamboo sword (used in kendo)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- One of the "Three Friends of Winter" (⟦{松竹梅|しょうちくばい}→松竹梅：19391_shouchikubai⟧) along with pine and plum, symbolizing resilience
- ⟦{松竹梅|しょうちくばい}→松竹梅：19391_shouchikubai⟧ is also used to rank quality levels (top/middle/standard) at restaurants
- ⟦{竹取|たけとり}→竹取：28465_taketori⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧ (The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter) is one of Japan's oldest stories
- Used extensively in traditional crafts: baskets, fences, utensils
